01 / SELECTED RESEARCH

Questions into methods.

A closer look at the problems, methods, and contributions behind my work.

MEDICAL IMAGE SEGMENTATIONPublished

MSAF-UNet

Bringing image priors and multi-scale attention together.

A pathology image segmentation method that combines texture and color preprocessing, automatically generated box prompts, and multi-scale attention fusion.

My contribution · First author · Model design, implementation, and manuscript writing.

IEEE Signal Processing Letters · 2025

Paper ↗Code ↗
Method & context

Edge operators, K-means clustering, and median filtering enhance image features. Box prompts supply spatial cues at encoder stages, while the MSAF module integrates information across branches and scales.

VISUAL STATE-SPACE MODELSSubmitted

UniVSSD-Net

A dual-branch framework for 2D and 3D medical images.

A universal segmentation framework built around visual state-space duality, with eight-direction 3D scanning and adaptive feature refinement for complex anatomical structures.

My contribution · First author · Formulation, model design, implementation, and manuscript writing.

Submitted to CVPR 2027

Method & context

The 3D non-causal state-space duality module extracts volumetric features through eight scanning directions. A dual-branch design combines pretrained representations with task-specific adaptation. This manuscript has been submitted to CVPR 2027; it has not been accepted for publication.

SPATIOTEMPORAL LEARNINGPublished

From demand to infrastructure

Transferable EV charging demand prediction and station planning.

Estimating charging demand in cities with limited data, then connecting those estimates to station siting and sizing. The project links spatiotemporal models with practical planning in Shanwei.

My contribution · Project lead · First author of the NPSIF paper; second author of the IEEE Access article.

NPSIF 2024 · IEEE Access 2025

Prediction paper ↗Planning paper ↗Code ↗
Method & context

My work covered data processing, prediction-model development, station siting and sizing models, and paper and patent writing. The project produced a charging infrastructure planning proposal for China Southern Power Grid’s Shanwei Power Supply Bureau.
